requirements: Register Cloudflare/clef-flash as a reference model only; do not admit it as a live model/provider/runtime through donor intake.
Reuse the existing FA3-DECISION-FABRIC-001 and FA3-SYSTEM-ONE-REFLEX-001 boundaries rather than creating a new decision authority.
Any later Clef-Flash model admission must remain behind FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001 and FA3-AUTH-HOST-RESOURCE-BROKER-001.
The existing provider-neutral logical route fa3-decision-system-one is the preferred integration point if compatibility is verified.
Preserve caller-bounded candidate/action sets; Clef-Flash may score only options already authorized by the calling FA3 authority.
Confidence/probability output is evidence only and must never grant authorization or execute an action.
Low-confidence and unsupported cases must hand off to System Two or human review according to existing Decision Fabric policy.
CPU-only viability is mandatory before local runtime admission; upstream H200 testing is not CPU evidence.
Quantized or alternative runtime formats must be independently verified with the Clef joint schema head; generic Qwen compatibility must not be assumed.
Pin the exact Hugging Face revision and verify model shard, joint-head, tokenizer/config and executable Python hashes before model promotion.
Review and sandbox joint_schema_model.py and any other executable model-side code before runtime admission.
Model acquisition must be explicit through Model Manager; no runtime network fetch or automatic install is permitted.
License & Rights must verify the Clef-Flash Apache-2.0 declaration and the Qwen3.5-9B Apache-2.0 base chain before distribution.
Cloudflare Workers AI is not admitted by this model donor intake; any hosted-service integration requires separate provider admission.
No silent local/cloud, provider, model, backend or device fallback is introduced.
Display-GPU selection rules, Hardware Safety Envelope and Software Coexistence remain unchanged.
Fixed capability baseline 175 remains unchanged; this source maps to existing decision/model capabilities.
Pending donor entries are excluded from canonical planning until FIFO admission and merge.
